11.hebrew: Vayomer Elohim tadshe ha'aretz deshe esev mazria zera etz peri oseh peri lemino asher zar'o vo al ha'aretz vayehi chen
11.greek: kai eipen ho theos blastēsatō hē gē botanēn chortou speiron sperma kata genos kai kath homoiotēta kai xylon karpimon poioun karpon hou to sperma autou en autō kata genos epi tēs gēs kai egeneto houtōs
11.aramaic: Va'amar YY tad'et ar'a dit'ah isba devar zar'eih mizdera ilan peirin aveid peirin lizneih di zar'eih beih al ar'a vahavah chen
11.latin: et ait germinet terra herbam virentem et facientem semen et lignum pomiferum faciens fructum iuxta genus suum cuius semen in semet ipso sit super terram et factum est ita
11.syriac: W-emar Alaha taphra' ar'a 'upya d-'esba d-mazra' zar'a l-koyaneh w-ilana d-pera d-'abed pera l-koyaneh d-zar'eh beh 'al ar'a w-hwa hakana
11.geez: Wa-yebē 'Egzi'abḥēr tābqwəl mədr ḥamalāla śā'r za-yəzarā' zar'a ba-ba-zamadu wa-'əḍa ḫəmar za-yəgabar fərē za-zar'u wəstētu
11.coptic: uoh peje phnuti je mare p-kahi tiouō n-ou-sim n-te-ou-sim ef-hi-sperma kata genos uoh ou-shshēn ef-iri n-ou-utah
11.armenian: Ew asac' Astuac. Błxesc'ē erkir z-dalari xotoy sermanołi sermn əst azgi, ew z-caṙ ptłaber

12.hebrew: Vatotze ha'aretz deshe esev mazria zera leminehu ve'etz oseh peri asher zar'o vo leminehu vayar Elohim ki tov
12.greek: kai exēnenken hē gē botanēn chortou speiron sperma kata genos kai kath homoiotēta kai xylon karpimon poioun karpon hou to sperma autou en autō kata genos epi tēs gēs kai eiden ho theos hoti kalon
12.aramaic: Ve'apeiqat ar'a dit'ah isba devar zar'eih mizdera lizneih ve'ilan aveid peirin di zar'eih beih lizneih vachaza YY arei tav
12.latin: et protulit terra herbam virentem et adferentem semen iuxta genus suum lignumque faciens fructum et habens unumquodque sementem secundum speciem suam et vidit Deus quod esset bonum
12.syriac: W-apqath ar'a 'upya d-'esba d-mazra' zar'a l-koyaneh w-ilana d-'abed pera d-zar'eh beh l-koyaneh w-chza Alaha d-shappir
12.geez: Wa-'awḍə'at mədr ḥamalāla śā'r za-yəzarā' zar'a ba-ba-zamadu wa-'əḍa za-yəgabar fərē za-zar'u wəstētu
12.coptic: uoh a p-kahi tiouō n-ou-sim n-te-ou-sim ef-hi-sperma kata genos uoh ou-shshēn ef-iri n-ou-utah kata genos
12.armenian: Ew ehan erkir z-dalari xotoy sermanołi sermn əst azgi, ew z-caṙ ptłaber

13.hebrew: Vayehi erev vayehi voker yom shelishi
13.greek: kai egeneto hespera kai egeneto prōi hēmera tritē
13.aramaic: Vahavah remash vahavah tzephar yoma telita'ah
13.latin: et factum est vespere et mane dies tertius
13.syriac: W-hwa ramsha w-hwa tsapra yawma tlithaya
13.coptic: uoh a ruhan shōpi uoh a htoou shōpi p-huu n-mah-shomt
13.armenian: Ew ełew ənd ereks ew ełew ənd aṙawōts ōr errord:

14.hebrew: Vayomer Elohim yehi me'orot birkiya hashamayim lehavdil bein hayom uvein halaylah vehayu le'otot ulemo'adim uleyamim veshanim
14.greek: kai eipen ho theos genēthētōsan phōstēres en tō stereōmati tou ouranou eis phausin epi tēs gēs tou diachōrizein ana meson tēs hēmeras kai ana meson tēs nyktos kai estōsan eis sēmeia kai eis kairous kai eis hēmeras kai eis eniautous
14.aramaic: Va'amar YY yehon nehorin birkiya dishomaya le'afrasha bein yemama uvein leilya vihon le'atin ulezimnin ulemimnei vehon yomin ushnin
14.latin: dixit autem Deus fiant luminaria in firmamento caeli et dividant diem ac noctem et sint in signa et tempora et dies et annos
14.syriac: W-emar Alaha nehwu nahira b-rqi'a d-shmaya l-maphrash bayth imama l-lilya w-nehwu l-athwatha w-l-zabna w-l-yomatha w-l-shnaya
14.geez: Wa-yebē 'Egzi'abḥēr la-yəkunu brhānāt wəsta ṭafara samāy kama yābrəhu diba mədr
14.coptic: uoh peje phnuti je mare han-phōstēr shōpi hn p-stereōma n-t-phe e p-ōrj n-t-mēte m-p-ehoou mn p-ejōrh
14.armenian: Ew asac' Astuac. Ełic'in lusawork' i hastatut'ean erknic', taloy loys yerkir

15.hebrew: Vehayu lim'orot birkiya hashamayim leha'ir al ha'aretz vayehi chen
15.greek: kai estōsan eis phausin en tō stereōmati tou ouranou hōste phainein epi tēs gēs kai egeneto houtōs
15.aramaic: Vihon linhorin birkiya dishomaya le'anhara al ar'a vahavah chen
15.latin: ut luceant in firmamento caeli et inluminent terram et factum est ita
15.syriac: W-nehwu l-nahira b-rqi'a d-shmaya l-manharu 'al ar'a w-hwa hakana
15.geez: Wa-la-yəkunu la-brhān wəsta ṭafara samāy kama yābrəhu diba mədr wa-kōna kamāhu
15.coptic: uoh mare ou-shōpi eu-ōini hn p-stereōma n-t-phe e er-ōini e-jen p-kahi uoh a-s-shōpi m-pairēti
15.armenian: Ew ełic'in i lusaworut'iwn i hastatut'ean erknic' cagel yerkir. Ew ełew aynpēs.

16.hebrew: Vaya'as Elohim et shnei hame'orot hagdolim et hama'or hagadol lememshelet hayom ve'et hama'or hakaton lememshelet halaylah ve'et hakochavim
16.greek: kai epoiēsen ho theos tous dyo phōstēras tous megalous ton phōstēra ton megan eis archas tēs hēmeras kai ton phōstēra ton elassō eis archas tēs nyktos kai tous asteras
16.aramaic: Va'avad YY yat treiy nehoraya ravrvaya yat nehora raba lemeshlat bimama veyat nehora ze'eira lemeshlat beleilya veyat kokhvaya
16.latin: fecitque Deus duo luminaria magna luminare maius ut praeesset diei et luminare minus ut praeesset nocti et stellas
16.syriac: W-'bad Alaha tren nahira rawrbe l-nahira raba l-shultana d-imama w-l-nahira z'ura l-shultana d-lilya w-l-kawkbe
16.geez: Wa-gabra 'Egzi'abḥēr kəl'ēta brhānāta 'abayta 'abiya brhāna kama yəkʷannən ma'ālta wa-nə'usa brhāna kama yəkʷannən lēlita wa-kawākəbtani
16.coptic: uoh a phnuti thamio n-ni-nishti n-phōstēr snau p-nishti n-phōstēr e p-ōrj m-p-ehoou uoh p-kuji e p-ōrj m-p-ejōrh mn ni-siou
16.armenian: Ew arar Astuac z-erkus lusaworsn z-mecamecs. z-lusaworn mec isxanut'ean tuənǰean, ew z-lusaworn p'ok'r isxanut'ean gišeroy, ew z-astełs:

17.hebrew: Vayiten otam Elohim birkiya hashamayim leha'ir al ha'aretz
17.greek: kai etheto autous ho theos en tō stereōmati tou ouranou hōste phainein epi tēs gēs
17.aramaic: Vihav yatehon YY birkiya dishomaya le'anhara al ar'a
17.latin: et posuit eas in firmamento caeli ut lucerent super terram
17.syriac: W-yhab enun Alaha b-rqi'a d-shmaya l-manharu 'al ar'a
17.geez: Wa-'anbarōmu 'Egzi'abḥēr wəsta ṭafara samāy kama yābrəhu diba mədr
17.coptic: uoh a phnuti xau hn p-stereōma n-t-phe e er-ōini e-jen p-kahi
17.armenian: Ew ed z-nosa Astuac i hastatut'ean erknic' cagel yerkir,

18.hebrew: Velimshol bayom uvalaylah ulehavdil bein ha'or uvein hachoshek vayar Elohim ki tov
18.greek: kai archein tēs hēmeras kai tēs nyktos kai diachōrizein ana meson tou phōtos kai ana meson tou skotous kai eiden ho theos hoti kalon
18.aramaic: Ulemeshlat bimama uveleilya ule'afrasha bein nehora uvein chashokha vachaza YY arei tav
18.latin: et praeessent diei ac nocti et dividerent lucem ac tenebras et vidit Deus quod esset bonum
18.syriac: W-l-mshlat b-imama w-b-lilya w-l-maphrash bayth nuhra l-cheshuka w-chza Alaha d-shappir
18.geez: Wa-kama yəkʷannənu ma'ālta wa-lēlita wa-yəfləṭu mā'əkala brhān wa-ṣelmat wa-rə'əya 'Egzi'abḥēr śannāy
18.coptic: uoh e er-shishi e-jen p-ehoou mn p-ejōrh uoh e p-ōrj n-t-mēte m-p-ōini mn p-kaki uoh a phnuti nau je nane-u
18.armenian: ew isxel tuənǰean ew gišeroy, ew meknel i mēǰ lusoyn ew i mēǰ xawarin: Ew etes Astuac zi bari ē:

19.hebrew: Vayehi erev vayehi voker yom revi'i
19.greek: kai egeneto hespera kai egeneto prōi hēmera tetartē
19.aramaic: Vahavah remash vahavah tzephar yoma revi'a'ah
19.latin: et factum est vespere et mane dies quartus
19.syriac: W-hwa ramsha w-hwa tsapra yawma rbi'aya
19.coptic: uoh a ruhan shōpi uoh a htoou shōpi p-huu n-mah-ftou
19.armenian: Ew ełew ənd ereks ew ełew ənd aṙawōts ōr c'orrord:

20.hebrew: Vayomer Elohim yishretzu hamayim sheretz nefesh chayah ve'of ye'ofef al ha'aretz al pnei rekiya hashamayim
20.greek: kai eipen ho theos exagagetō ta hydata herpeta psychōn zōsōn kai peteina petomena epi tēs gēs kata to stereōma tou ouranou kai egeneto houtōs
20.aramaic: Va'amar YY yerachashun maya rachsha nafsha chayeta ve'ofa yefarach al ar'a al apei reqiya dishomaya
20.latin: dixit etiam Deus producant aquae reptile animae viventis et volatile super terram sub firmamento caeli
20.syriac: W-emar Alaha narhshun maya rachsha naphsha chayatha w-prakhta taphrakh 'al ar'a 'al apei rqi'a d-shmaya
20.geez: Wa-yebē 'Egzi'abḥēr tāwḍə' māy za-yətḥawas nafsa ḥəyāwa wa-za-yəbarər lā'la mədr wəsta ṭafara samāy
20.coptic: uoh peje phnuti je mare ni-moou en han-psukhē eu-onh ebol uoh han-halati eu-hōl e-jen p-kahi kata p-stereōma n-t-phe
20.armenian: Ew asac' Astuac. Hanc'en ǰurk' zeṙuns šnč'oc' kendaneac', ew t'ṙč'uns t'ṙuc'eals yerkir əst hastatut'ean erknic': Ew ełew aynpēs:

21.hebrew: Vayivra Elohim et hataninim hagdolim ve'et kol nefesh hachayah haromeset asher shartzu hamayim leminehem ve'et kol of kanaf leminehu vayar Elohim ki tov
21.greek: kai epoiēsen ho theos ta kētē ta megala kai pasan psychēn zōōn herpetōn ha exēgagen ta hydata kata genē autōn kai pan peteinon pterōton kata genos kai eiden ho theos hoti kala
21.aramaic: Uvera YY yat taninaya ravrvaya veyat kol nafsha chayeta derachasha de'archishu maya liznehon veyat kol ofa defarach lizneih vachaza YY arei tav
21.latin: creavitque Deus cete grandia et omnem animam viventem atque motabilem quam produxerant aquae in species suas et omne volatile secundum genus suum et vidit Deus quod esset bonum
21.syriac: W-bra Alaha tanine rawrbe w-khol naphsha chayatha d-rachsha d-arhshu maya l-koyanehun w-khol prakhta d-prakha l-koyaneh w-chza Alaha d-shappir
21.geez: Wa-faṭara 'Egzi'abḥēr 'anbarita 'abayta wa-kʷəlo nafsa ḥəyāwa za-yətḥawas za-'awḍə'a māy ba-ba-zamadu wa-kʷəlo 'ōfa za-yəbarər ba-ba-zamadu wa-rə'əya 'Egzi'abḥēr śannāy
21.coptic: uoh a phnuti thamio n-ni-nishti n-kētos mn psukhē niben e-tonh e-te-shashf e-ta ni-moou en-u ebol kata genos uoh halati niben n-tenh kata genos uoh a phnuti nau je nane-u
21.armenian: Ew arar Astuac z-kēts mecamecs, ew z-amenayn šunč' kendani zeṙnoc' zor hanin ǰurk' əst azgi iwreanc', ew z-amenayn t'ṙč'uns t'ewawors əst azgi iwreanc': Ew etes Astuac zi bari ē:

22.hebrew: Vayevarech otam Elohim lemor pru urvu umil'u et hamayim bayamim veha'of yirev ba'aretz
22.greek: kai eulogēsen auta ho theos legōn auxanesthe kai plēthynesthe kai plērōsate ta hydata en tais thalassais kai ta peteina plēthynesthōsan epi tēs gēs
22.aramaic: Uvareich yatehon YY lemeimar pushu usego umelo yat maya beyamaya ve'ofa yisgei be'ar'a
22.latin: benedixitque eis dicens crescite et multiplicamini et replete aquas maris avesque multiplicentur super terram
22.syriac: W-barekh enun Alaha w-emar pru w-sgu w-mlu maya d-b-yamme w-prakhta tasge b-ar'a
22.geez: Wa-bārakōmu 'Egzi'abḥēr wa-yebē tabāzu wa-tabāzḫu wa-mlə'əwā la-māy wəsta bāḥər wa-'ōfni yəbzaḫ ba-mədr
22.coptic: uoh a phnuti smou ero-u ef-jō m-mos je ai-ai uoh ashai uoh mah ni-moou n-te ni-iom uoh ni-halati mar-u-ashai hi-jen p-kahi
22.armenian: Ew ōrhneac' z-nosa Astuac ew asē. Ačec'ēk' ew bazmac'aruk', ew lc'ēk' z-ǰurs covac', ew t'ṙč'unk' bazmasc'in i veray erkri:

23.hebrew: Vayehi erev vayehi voker yom chamishi
23.greek: kai egeneto hespera kai egeneto prōi hēmera pemptē
23.aramaic: Vahavah remash vahavah tzephar yoma chamisha'ah
23.latin: et factum est vespere et mane dies quintus
23.syriac: W-hwa ramsha w-hwa tsapra yawma chamishaya
23.coptic: uoh a ruhan shōpi uoh a htoou shōpi p-huu n-mah-tiou
23.armenian: Ew ełew ənd ereks ew ełew ənd aṙawōts ōr hingerord:

24.hebrew: Vayomer Elohim totze ha'aretz nefesh chayah leminah behemah varemes vechayto eretz leminah vayehi chen
24.greek: kai eipen ho theos exagagetō hē gē psychēn zōsan kata genos tetrapoda kai herpeta kai thēria tēs gēs kata genos kai egeneto houtōs
24.aramaic: Va'amar YY tapeiq ar'a nafsha chayeta liznah be'ira verachsha vechayat ar'a liznah vahavah chen
24.latin: dixit quoque Deus producat terra animam viventem in genere suo iumenta et reptilia et bestias terrae secundum species suas factumque est ita
24.syriac: W-emar Alaha tpaq ar'a naphsha chayatha l-koyaneh b'ira w-rachsha w-chayuth ar'a l-koyaneh w-hwa hakana
24.geez: Wa-yebē 'Egzi'abḥēr tāwḍə' mədr nafsa ḥəyāwa ba-ba-zamadu 'arāwita wa-'ənsəsā wa-za-yətḥawas diba mədr ba-ba-zamadu wa-kōna kamāhu
24.coptic: uoh peje phnuti je mare p-kahi en-ou-psukhē e-s-onh ebol kata genos han-tebnooui mn han-chatfi mn han-thērion n-te p-kahi kata genos uoh a-s-shōpi m-pairēti
24.armenian: Ew asac' Astuac. Hanc'ē erkir šunč' kendani əst azgi, č'ork'otanis, ew sołuns, ew gazans erkri əst azgi: Ew ełew aynpēs:

25.hebrew: Vaya'as Elohim et chayat ha'aretz leminah ve'et habehemah leminah ve'et kol remes ha'adamah leminehu vayar Elohim ki tov
25.greek: kai epoiēsen ho theos ta thēria tēs gēs kata genos kai ta ktēnē kata genos kai panta ta herpeta tēs gēs kata genos autōn kai eiden ho theos hoti kala
25.aramaic: Va'avad YY yat chayat ar'a liznah veyat be'ira liznah veyat kol rachsha de'ar'a lizneih vachaza YY arei tav
25.latin: et fecit Deus bestias terrae iuxta species suas et iumenta et omne reptile terrae in genere suo et vidit Deus quod esset bonum
25.syriac: W-'bad Alaha chayuth ar'a l-koyaneh w-b'ira l-koyaneh w-khol rachsha d-ar'a l-koyaneh w-chza Alaha d-shappir
25.geez: Wa-gabra 'Egzi'abḥēr 'arāwita mədr ba-ba-zamadu wa-'ənsəsā ba-ba-zamadu wa-kʷəlo za-yətḥawas diba mədr ba-ba-zamadu wa-rə'əya 'Egzi'abḥēr śannāy
25.coptic: uoh a phnuti thamio n-ni-thērion n-te p-kahi kata genos mn ni-tebnooui kata genos mn chatfi niben n-te p-kahi kata genos uoh a phnuti nau je nane-u
25.armenian: Ew arar Astuac z-gazans erkri əst azgi, ew z-anasuns əst azgi, ew z-amenayn sołuns erkri əst azgi iwreanc': Ew etes Astuac zi bari ē:

26.hebrew: Vayomer Elohim na'aseh adam betzalmenu kidmutenu veyirdu vidgat hayam uve'of hashamayim uvabehemah uvekhol ha'aretz uvekhol haremes haromes al ha'aretz
26.greek: kai eipen ho theos poiēsōmen anthrōpon kat eikona hēmeteran kai kath homoiōsin kai archetōsan tōn ichthyōn tēs thalassēs kai tōn peteinōn tou ouranou kai tōn ktēnōn kai pasēs tēs gēs kai pantōn tōn herpetōn tōn herpontōn epi tēs gēs
26.aramaic: Va'amar YY na'aveid enasha betzalmana kidmutana veyishletun benunei yama uve'ofa dishomaya uvive'ira uvekhol ar'a uvekhol rachsha deracheish al ar'a
26.latin: et ait faciamus hominem ad imaginem et similitudinem nostram et praesit piscibus maris et volatilibus caeli et bestiis universaeque terrae omnique reptili quod movetur in terra
26.syriac: W-emar Alaha na'bed barnasha b-tsalman ayk dmuthan w-neshletun b-nune d-yama w-b-prakhta d-shmaya w-b-b'ira w-b-kholah ar'a w-b-khol rachsha d-rachesh 'al ar'a
26.geez: Wa-yebē 'Egzi'abḥēr nəgbar sab'a ba-'ar'āyāna wa-ba-'amsālina wa-yəkʷannənwōmu la-'āśāta bāḥər wa-la-'a'wāfa samāy wa-la-'ənsəsā wa-la-kʷəlu mədr wa-la-kʷəlu za-yətḥawas diba mədr
26.coptic: uoh peje phnuti je mar-n-thamio n-ou-rōmi kata pen-hini uoh kata pen-ine uoh mar-ou-er-shishi e-jen ni-tebt n-te ph-iom mn ni-halati n-te t-phe mn ni-tebnooui mn p-kahi tērf
26.armenian: Ew asac' Astuac. Arasc'uk' mard əst patkeri merum ew əst nmanut'ean. ew isxesc'en jkanc' covu, ew t'ṙč'noc' erknic', ew anasnoc', ew amenayn erkri, ew amenayn sołnoc' or sołan i veray erkri:

27.hebrew: Vayivra Elohim et ha'adam betzalmo betzelem Elohim bara oto zachar unekevah bara otam
27.greek: kai epoiēsen ho theos ton anthrōpon kat eikona theou epoiēsen auton arsen kai thēly epoiēsen autous
27.aramaic: Uvera YY yat adam betzalmeih betzelem Elohim bera yateih dekhar venukva bera yatehon
27.latin: et creavit Deus hominem ad imaginem suam ad imaginem Dei creavit illum masculum et feminam creavit eos
27.syriac: W-bra Alaha l-barnasha b-tsalmeh b-tslam Alaha brāyhy dkhar w-neqba bra enun
27.geez: Wa-faṭara 'Egzi'abḥēr sab'a ba-'ar'āya 'Egzi'abḥēr faṭarō tabā'ta wa-'anəsta faṭarōmu
27.coptic: uoh a phnuti thamio m-p-rōmi kata p-hini m-phnuti af-thamio-f ou-hōout mn ou-shhimi af-thamio-u
27.armenian: Ew arar Astuac z-mardn i patker iwr, əst patkeri Astucoy arar z-na, aru ew ēg arar z-nosa:

28.hebrew: Vayevarech otam Elohim vayomer lahem Elohim pru urvu umil'u et ha'aretz vechivshuha uredu bidgat hayam uve'of hashamayim uvekhol chayah haromeset al ha'aretz
28.greek: kai eulogēsen autous ho theos legōn auxanesthe kai plēthynesthe kai plērōsate tēn gēn kai katakyrieusate autēs kai archete tōn ichthyōn tēs thalassēs kai tōn peteinōn tou ouranou kai pantōn tōn ktēnōn kai pasēs tēs gēs kai pantōn tōn herpetōn tōn herpontōn epi tēs gēs
28.aramaic: Uvareich yatehon YY va'amar lehon YY pushu usego umelo yat ar'a ukhvushuha ushlitu benunei yama uve'ofa dishomaya uvekhol chayeta derachasha al ar'a
28.latin: benedixitque illis Deus et ait crescite et multiplicamini et replete terram eamque subicite et dominamini piscibus maris e volatilibus caeli et universis animantibus quae moventur super terram
28.syriac: W-barekh enun Alaha w-emar lhun Alaha pru w-sgu w-mlu ar'a w-khbashwh w-shlatu b-nune d-yama w-b-prakhta d-shmaya w-b-khol chayutha d-rachsha 'al ar'a
28.geez: Wa-bārakōmu 'Egzi'abḥēr wa-yebēlōmu 'Egzi'abḥēr tabāzu wa-tabāzḫu wa-mlə'əwā la-mədr wa-kʷannənwā wa-gəz'əwā la-'āśāta bāḥər wa-la-'a'wāfa samāy wa-la-kʷəlu 'ənsəsā za-yətḥawas diba mədr
28.coptic: uoh a phnuti smou ero-u ef-jō m-mos je ai-ai uoh ashai uoh mah p-kahi uoh a-mah-tēouti m-mo-f uoh er-shishi e-jen ni-tebt n-te ph-iom mn ni-halati n-te t-phe
28.armenian: Ew ōrhneac' z-nosa Astuac ew asē. Ačec'ēk' ew bazmac'aruk', ew lc'ēk' z-erkir, ew tirec'ēk' dma, ew isxec'ēk' jkanc' covu, ew t'ṙč'noc' erknic', ew amenayn anasnoc', ew amenayn sołnoc' or sołan i veray erkri:

29.hebrew: Vayomer Elohim hineh natati lachem et kol esev zorea zera asher al pnei kol ha'aretz ve'et kol ha'etz asher bo fri etz zorea zara lachem yihyeh le'ochlah
29.greek: kai eipen ho theos idou dedōka hymin panta chorton sporimon speiron sperma ho estin epanō pasēs tēs gēs kai pan xylon ho echei en heautō karpon spermatos sporimou hymin estai eis brōsin
29.aramaic: Va'amar YY ha yehavit lekhon yat kol isba devar zar'eih mizdera di al apei kol ar'a veyat kol ilana di beih peirei ilana devar zar'eih mizdera lekhon yehei lemeichal
29.latin: dixitque Deus ecce dedi vobis omnem herbam afferentem semen super terram et universa ligna quae habent in semet ipsis sementem generis sui ut sint vobis in escam
29.syriac: W-emar Alaha ha yahbeth lkhun khol 'esba d-mazra' zar'a d-'al apei kholah ar'a w-khol ilana d-beh pera d-ilana d-mazra' zar'a lkhun nehwa l-ma'khulta
29.geez: Wa-yebē 'Egzi'abḥēr nāhu wahabkukmu kʷəlo śā'ra za-yəzarā' zar'a za-diba kʷəlu mədr wa-kʷəlo 'əḍa za-bōtu fərē zar'ə za-yəzarā' lakmu yəkun la-sisāy
29.coptic: uoh peje phnuti je hēppe ai-ti nō-tn n-sim niben ef-hi-sperma e-te hi-jen ph-ho m-p-kahi tērf mn shshēn niben e-te ou-on utah n-hi-sperma n-shshēn n-hēt-f nō-tn ef-e-shōpi eu-xrēsis
29.armenian: Ew asac' Astuac. Aha etu jez z-amenayn xot sermaneli sermanoł sermn or i veray amenayn erkri, ew z-amenayn caṙ or unic'i iwr ptuł sermaneloy sermn. jez ełic'i i kerakur:

30.hebrew: Ulechol chayat ha'aretz ulechol of hashamayim ulechol romes al ha'aretz asher bo nefesh chayah et kol yerek esev le'ochlah vayehi chen
30.greek: kai pasi tois thēriois tēs gēs kai pasi tois peteinois tou ouranou kai panti herpetō herponti epi tēs gēs ho echei en heautō psychēn zōēs panta chorton chlōron eis brōsin kai egeneto houtōs
30.aramaic: Ulekhol chayat ar'a ulekhol ofa dishomaya ulekhol deracheish al ar'a di beih nafsha chayeta yat kol yerok isba lemeichal vahavah chen
30.latin: et cunctis animantibus terrae omnique volucri caeli et universis quae moventur in terra et in quibus est anima vivens ut habeant ad vescendum et factum est ita
30.syriac: W-l-khol chayuth ar'a w-l-khol prakhta d-shmaya w-l-khol rachsha d-'al ar'a d-beh naphsha chayatha khol yuraqa d-'esba l-ma'khulta w-hwa hakana
30.geez: Wa-la-kʷəlu 'arāwita mədr wa-la-kʷəlu 'a'wāfa samāy wa-la-kʷəlu za-yətḥawas diba mədr za-bōtu nafsa ḥəyāwa kʷəlo ḥamalāla śā'r la-sisāy wa-kōna kamāhu
30.coptic: uoh n-ni-thērion tēru n-te p-kahi mn ni-halati tēru n-te t-phe mn chatfi niben e-te-shōp hi-jen p-kahi e-te ou-on psukhē n-onh n-hēt-f sim niben e-touēt eu-xrēsis uoh a-s-shōpi m-pairēti
30.armenian: Ew amenayn gazanac' erkri, ew amenayn t'ṙč'noc' erknic', ew amenayn sołnoc' or sołan i veray erkri yors ē šunč' kendanut'ean, z-amenayn xot dalari i kerakur: Ew ełew aynpēs:

31.hebrew: Vayar Elohim et kol asher asah vehineh tov me'od vayehi erev vayehi voker yom hashishi
31.greek: kai eiden ho theos ta panta hosa epoiēsen kai idou kala lian kai egeneto hespera kai egeneto prōi hēmera hektē
31.aramaic: Vachaza YY yat kol di'avad veha tav lachda vahavah remash vahavah tzephar yoma shetita'ah
31.latin: viditque Deus cuncta quae fecit et erant valde bona et factum est vespere et mane dies sextus
31.syriac: W-chza Alaha khol d-'bad w-ha shappir tab w-hwa ramsha w-hwa tsapra yawma shtithaya
31.geez: Wa-rə'əya 'Egzi'abḥēr kʷəlo za-gabra wa-nāhu śannāy ṭəqa wa-kōna śark wa-kōna nagh sāds 'elat
31.coptic: uoh a phnuti nau e hōb niben e-ta-f-thamio-u uoh hēppe nane-u emashō uoh a ruhan shōpi uoh a htoou shōpi p-huu n-mah-soou
31.armenian: Ew etes Astuac z-amenayn zor arar, ew aha bari en yoyž: Ew ełew ənd ereks ew ełew ənd aṙawōts ōr vec'erord:
